skip-signature-check.description: verifyRequest accepts before looking at the secret, the signature or the timestamp: any POST is processed.
expectedFailures: refuses no signature header
refuses another secret
refuses body changed after signing
refuses timestamp 6 minutes old
refuses timestamp 6 minutes ahead
refuses non-numeric timestamp
refuses non-hex signature
refuses everything when no secret is configured
refuses a signed request replayed after the freshness window

no-tool-call-ledger.description: A redelivered tool call id no longer answers its stored outcome: the tool runs again.
expectedFailures: S4: a late redelivery after the caller cancelled

no-slot-unique-index.description: The one-live-booking-per-slot index becomes a plain index: the database no longer refuses a second booking on a slot.
expectedFailures: S6: two callers racing for one slot
S6: a reschedule onto a taken slot
S7: a deposit paid after the hold ran out
S7: with Stripe unreachable when the hold runs out
4. double-booking attempt

no-recall-lookup.description: book_appointment no longer looks for the booking this call already made: the model re-calling the tool is treated as a new booking.
expectedFailures: killed after the booking committed
S5: the model re-calling book_appointment
S5: a second slot in the same call

fresh-stripe-key.description: The Stripe Idempotency-Key gets a random suffix: a retry after a lost answer or a crash creates a second Checkout Session.
expectedFailures: killed after Stripe created the session
S7: a lost Stripe answer is retried with the same key

release-without-asking-stripe.description: An expired hold is released without asking Stripe whether the deposit was paid.
expectedFailures: S7: a deposit paid after the hold ran out
S7: with Stripe unreachable when the hold runs out

no-ownership-check.description: Any caller who knows a booking ref can move, cancel or pay for it.
expectedFailures: only the caller who booked can move or cancel it
a phone number said on another line is not proof of ownership
